Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Birendra Singh Adhikari, Advocate, 
for the appellant.
Mr. Himanshu Yadav, Advocate, for 
respondent No. 1.
The Urgency Application No. 
IA/3/2023, has been preferred by the 
appellant on the ground, that the appellant is 
92 years of age and craving for an early 
adjudication.
Since the First Appeal has already 
been admitted, let it be posted in the week 
commencing 02.01.2024 for final adjudication.
Accordingly, IA/3/2023 would stand 
allowed.
It has been informed that the paper 
book has already been prepared by the 
Registry; the parties may collect the same as 
per rules.
